header.title: उत्पाद
header.description: Software and productised lab offerings you can run: AI GPU workstations, agentic frameworks, Claude Code / Cowork and ChatGPT for teams — plus WSL Proxy, Ring Promoter, AI Labs, CRM, and marketing tools.

agenticFrameworks.title: Top AI agentic frameworks & orchestration
agenticFrameworks.subtitle: LangChain / LangGraph, Apache Airflow, and enterprise workflow patterns we operationalise in AI Labs
agenticFrameworks.description: Agent frameworks alone do not make production systems. We combine graph-based agents with durable orchestration, approval gates, and observability so enterprise workflows survive real traffic.
agenticFrameworks.articleLabel: Read the enterprise agentic frameworks guide

items.title: LangChain & LangGraph
items.description: Composable LLM apps and stateful agent graphs — tool calling, human-in-the-loop interrupts, and durable checkpointing for long-horizon enterprise agents.

items.title: LangSmith & evaluation
items.description: Tracing, datasets, and eval loops so agent regressions are caught before promotion through int → test → acc → prod rings.

items.title: Apache Airflow 3
items.description: Durable DAGs for data prep, model refresh, RAG ingest, and scheduled agent jobs — Apache Airflow 3.x remains the enterprise backbone for batch and hybrid agent workflows.

items.title: Enterprise workflow patterns
items.description: MCP connectors, approval gates, Ring Promoter health-gated deploys, and OpenTelemetry cost control — the operational layer that makes agent demos survivable in production.

codingAgents.title: Claude Code, Claude Cowork & ChatGPT for business teams
codingAgents.subtitle: Latest coding agents and team copilots — mapped to engineering, ops, finance, and GTM workflows
codingAgents.description: Anthropic’s Claude Code and Claude Cowork, plus OpenAI ChatGPT / Agents SDK models, are how business teams actually ship with AI today. We help you pick the right surface per team and run them with governance.
codingAgents.articleLabel: Read the Claude Code / Cowork & ChatGPT teams guide

items.title: Claude Code
items.description: Anthropic’s agentic coding product for repository-scale work: multi-file edits, tests, and long-running coding agents in the terminal or IDE — suited to platform, SRE, and product engineering squads.
capabilities: Pairs with Claude models on Platform / Bedrock

items.title: Claude Cowork
items.description: Anthropic’s Claude Cowork product for desk-to-phone task workflows: connect data, schedule recurring work, and deliver decks, documents, or spreadsheets for human review — positioned for business teams beyond pure coding.

items.title: ChatGPT & OpenAI Agents
items.description: ChatGPT Team / Enterprise surfaces plus OpenAI Agents SDK / Agents API for custom tool-using agents. Current model lineup includes GPT-5.6-class and GPT-6-class APIs for reasoning, realtime, and multimodal team workflows.

items.title: Team playbooks by function
items.description: We map agents to finance, legal, support, marketing, and DevOps with MCP OAuth, Vault leases, and approval gates — so copilots help without becoming shadow IT.

featured.title: AI वाइब कोडिंग प्लेटफॉर्म
featured.subtitle: AI-पावर्ड डेवलपमेंट के साथ 10 गुना तेज ऐप्स बनाएं
featured.description: AI वाइब कोडिंग के साथ अपने डेवलपमेंट वर्कफ्लो को बदलें — वह क्रांतिकारी दृष्टिकोण जो आपको प्राकृतिक भाषा का उपयोग करके पूर्ण एप्लिकेशन बनाने देता है। Cursor IDE, GPT-4, Claude और Gemini द्वारा संचालित, हमारा प्लेटफॉर्म डेवलपर्स और नॉन-डेवलपर्स दोनों को कन्वर्सेशनल AI के माध्यम से प्रोडक्शन-रेडी iOS, Android और वेब एप्लिकेशन बनाने में सक्षम बनाता है।

options.name: कस्टम AI ऐप डेवलपमेंट
